recentItems.title: No Deepam At Deepathoon| T.N Govt Defies SC, Then Says Sorry| 'Shah Bano Moment' For Team Congress?
recentItems.description:
Chief Minister Vijay-led Tamil Nadu govt defied Supreme Court';s order of letting the Karthigai deepam lit at the disputed Deepathoon stone pillar. However, the Karthigai deepam was lit on at the Uchipillayar mandapam in Thirupparankundram. A day after defying the order, Tamil Nadu govt apologised in an affidavit filed in the Supreme Court. recentItems.title: Trump’s Thanksgiving Speech LIVE: Shocking Message Leaves Americans Stunned! Major Changes Next?
recentItems.description:
WASHINGTON EMERGENCY LIVE: President Donald Trump turns the 79th National Thanksgiving Turkey Pardoning ceremony at the White House into a high-stakes political showcase, questioning the recent midterm election results while unveiling major structural changes to White House traditions. Joined by the First Lady to pardon turkeys Freedom and Feathers from West Virginia, Trump demanded answers over the GOP's midterm losses, touted market gains, and announced that next year's Thanksgiving turkeys will be housed inside the massive new White House ballroom currently under construction rather than the Willard Hotel.

Watch direct live coverage as political correspondents, Washington analysts, and Capitol Hill observers break down Trump's remarks on the midterm fallout, economic shifts, and incoming executive maneuvers.

recentItems.title: Punjab: SAD, BJP United In NDA, Divided By Issues? Bandi Sikh To Drug Menace, Shah, Akalis Jolt AAP?
recentItems.description:
NDA’S one of the oldest parties, Shiromani Akali Dal, is back in the pact. For many political pundits, this BJP-SAD alliance was bound to happen. After around six years of friction, Sukhbir Singh Badal has once again held the hand of Home Minister Amit Shah. The Chanakya of the saffron party said that both the parties took their time and had discussions on different issues before teaming up again. Sukhbir Singh Badal, along with Home Minister Amit Shah, held a joint press conference in Delhi on November 24 after joining the alliance. Union Home Minister answered most of the questions, and the two looked cautious about spilling out the numbers. As we expect from any alliance, the two sides tried to remain on the same page on different complex friction points, such as the now repealed farm laws, and also the issue of Bandi Sikhs. Watch the video to know more details.
